facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: fire on CY-3212 during cleaning and preparation

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was lost time injury, with 1 person injured and 4 days lost.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on CY-3212 and PT-3212 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices on CY-3212 and PT-3212 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on CY-3212 and PT-3212 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically managing corrosion and thinning findings. CY-3212 (cyclone clusters) is in service for classification duty on the grinding circuit. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 3 May 2023 an incident occurred on CY-3212 and PT-3212 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during cleaning and preparation, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
